business_process: Building access control and tenant credentialing
description: Issue, change, and disable fobs and phone credentials; door schedules; after-hours entry at Property A; rear service doors and utility room at Property B
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Door controllers keep working on cached credentials and schedules for up to 72 hours, but no credential can be issued or disabled. A lost or departed holder's fob that cannot be disabled is a physical security gap at night; after one day the company must post a guard. Credential changes made in a day can be re-entered from the request forms
manual_workaround: Doors run on cached credentials and schedules; on-call guard from a local guard company at the Property A front entrance after hours; mechanical key override held by the Property Manager and Building Engineer; paper log of credential requests to enter later
dependent_third_parties: Access control and video platform vendor; security integrator; internet provider; MSP (Property A firewall)
dependent_people_or_facilities: Property Manager; Tenant Services and Leasing Coordinator; management office

business_process: Building environmental control at Property A (HVAC, lighting, metering)
description: Supervisory control of 4 rooftop units and 48 VAV boxes through the BAS; schedules; alarms; tenant after-hours HVAC requests; utility meter reads
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Field controllers keep their last programs, so tenants stay cool at first. Without the workstation the engineer cannot see alarms or change schedules; after one day, comfort complaints and tenant server-room heat build in the Florida climate. Leases allow rent abatement after 5 consecutive business days of untenantable premises. Schedules and graphics change rarely, so a day of lost changes is acceptable
manual_workaround: Building Engineer runs rooftop units in hand at each unit; Maintenance Technicians do 2-hour rounds and log temperatures; fixed occupied schedule; the controls contractor brings a laptop to reach the supervisory controller directly
dependent_third_parties: Controls contractor; MSP; cloud backup service (MSP subcontractor)
dependent_people_or_facilities: Building Engineer; 2 Maintenance Technicians; engineering room

description: Email and tenant portal notices to 33 tenant contacts; service interruption notices; security incident notices under lease clauses; calls to the management office
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Leases require notice of building service interruptions, and leases signed since 2024 require notice within 72 hours of unauthorized access to tenant employees' data in the access control system. Tenants must be told what to expect the same business day
manual_workaround: Printed tenant contact list in the incident binder; Property Manager's cell phone; notices posted at entrances; tenant portal from any clean device
dependent_third_parties: Productivity suite vendor; property management system vendor; phone carrier
dependent_people_or_facilities: Property Manager; Tenant Services and Leasing Coordinator

description: 28 cameras at both properties; review of footage for tenant incidents, police requests, and after-hours alerts
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Cameras do not keep footage locally, so recording stops during an outage. Police and insurers ask for footage after incidents; two days without recording is tolerable with patrols
manual_workaround: Maintenance Technician walks both properties at opening and closing; on-call guard patrols at night; cameras resume recording when the network returns
dependent_third_parties: Access control and video platform vendor; security integrator; internet providers

business_process: Engineering work orders and tenant service requests
description: Tenant requests through the portal; preventive maintenance schedules; contractor dispatch
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Tenants expect a response the same day for hot and cold calls and leaks; requests entered in the last few hours must not be lost
manual_workaround: Tenants call or email the management office; paper work order forms; enter into the system later
dependent_third_parties: Property management system vendor; internet providers
dependent_people_or_facilities: Building Engineer; Maintenance Technicians; Tenant Services and Leasing Coordinator

business_process: Rent billing, ACH collection, and tenant accounting
description: Monthly rent and expense recovery invoices; ACH collection through the tenant portal; payables to contractors; bank reconciliation
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $92,000 a month, most collected in the first week of the month; a vendor-hosted ledger with continuous saves. Three days of delay at month start strains cash flow
manual_workaround: Prior month's rent roll printed each month; tenants pay by check; delay non-urgent payables; the cash reserve covers about 45 days of expenses
dependent_third_parties: Property management system vendor and its payment partner; bank

description: Fob replacement fees, after-hours HVAC charges, conference room bookings, and Property B kiosk fees on the P2PE terminal
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 600 transactions a year. Charges can be invoiced instead. The terminal is stand-alone on cellular and normally unaffected by a network incident
manual_workaround: Invoice the tenant through the property management system; never write card numbers down
dependent_people_or_facilities: Tenant Services and Leasing Coordinator; Bookkeeper

business_process: Leasing, tenant screening, and lease files
description: Prospect tours; applications; tenant screening and credit reports on guarantors; lease drafting and storage
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Leasing deals take weeks; executed leases are also stored in the property management system. Applicant files hold the most sensitive personal information, so integrity and confidentiality matter more than speed
manual_workaround: Work from executed leases in the property management system and the attorney's copies; pause new screenings
dependent_third_parties: Productivity suite vendor; cloud backup service; tenant screening service; outside real estate attorney
dependent_people_or_facilities: Tenant Services and Leasing Coordinator; Managing Member

description: Biweekly payroll for 7 employees through the payroll service; HR files in the shared drive
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payroll runs every two weeks and the payroll service holds the data; HR files change rarely
manual_workaround: Payroll service repeats the prior payroll; Bookkeeper signs in from any clean device
